phase_reset_credit.behavior: Both boss AIs call BossAI reset, return to PHASE_INTRO, and restore share-health auras; not every helper counter/waypoint is explicitly reinitialized.
Valiona schedules Blackout/Devouring and Theralion calls liftoff; both engage the encounter frame; heroic path applies Twilight Shift and Valiona dummy auras.

Theralion's three Dazzling passes lead to landing and Valiona's three randomized Deep Breath lane passes lead to landing; movement travel time is part of local implementation and not a 4.4.2 guarantee.
Either boss disengages, restores gravity, despawns its summons, and calls _DespawnAtEvade; instance FAIL delays Valiona dummy/Unstable cleanup 30s and clears selected GUID sets.

Ground-phase death casts sibling instakill 95741/95742, then generic _JustDied and encounter-frame disengage; instance DONE cleans dummy/Unstable and schedules Cho'gall response after6s. Loot, achievement, and retail lockout credit are not proven.
Map671 uses DATA_THERALION_AND_VALIONA=1 with boss entries 45993 Theralion and45992 Valiona; loader registers AddSC_boss_theralion_and_valiona.

Local engage adds Twilight Shift and Twilight Zone/Sentry periodic hooks only in heroic; Engulfing local cap is one for non-25-player maps and up to three for 25-player maps. Exact retail coefficients and target tables remain unresolved.
Historical TDB/SQL identifies level-88 entries 45992/45993, ScriptNames boss_valiona/boss_theralion, model bindings, and map671 support spawns; base health is not four-mode current tuning.

Current Wowhead and historical Icy Veins health tables differ materially; local TDB base health is not a current four-mode table.

Narrative/table damage, absorb, expiry, radius, and local removal semantics are not reconciled to 4.4.2 spell data.
Cone, tick, distance formula, lane damage, and mode values require validated spell/DBC data.
Local stalker/phase filters and guide zone counts/telegraphs do not establish current client target geometry.
Current 1-3 wording, historical size counts, and local class/raid-size exclusions conflict.
Current random-target prose conflicts with local ground-tank exclusion and local1.2s repeat; warning and split values differ.
Current/historical transition timestamps differ from local three-pass movement; lane, cast, and realm damage data are incomplete.
Twilight Zone, Unstable Twilight, portal lifetime/count, and realm reset values are not fully represented in C++.
Local periodic setup has no exact cadence; guide estimates do not establish target, Rift Blast, or mode coefficients.
